mentions.h: FROM 'THE BELGRAVIAN' 25 years ago ... and 40 years ago
mentions.note: lost his mother and sister when their home was destroyed
died 24 September 2008 in his 84th year; joined July 1942; 6 miles 29:54.8 (1955), 3 miles 13:52.4 (1956); later Cambridge Harriers
